name: RTW Affiliate Program for WooCommerce
author: RedefiningTheWeb

sections.description:
Affiliate Program for WooCommerce is a free WooCommerce affiliate plugin. It runs your own affiliate program in your store: affiliates share a referral link and earn commission on the orders they refer. It covers the essentials of WooCommerce affiliate marketing: referral tracking, commission rules, performance bonuses, an affiliate dashboard and manual payouts. Program data stays in your WordPress database, and the plugin itself calls no external service (see Privacy).

  • Live Demo: try the program as a store admin or as an affiliate. The demo runs the Pro plugin, so it also shows Pro features; Free vs Pro below lists what is free.
  • Documentation: setup, commission rules, tracking and payouts.
  • Support: support@redefiningtheweb.com

How your WooCommerce affiliate program works

  1. An affiliate signs up and is approved automatically. A deactivated affiliate stays off until you reactivate them.
  2. They share their referral link. A cookie credits them for the visitor’s next order within the days you set.
  3. A referred order records one commission. You approve it, or let a chosen order status approve it, and it joins the affiliate’s balance.
  4. The affiliate requests a payout. You pay it outside the plugin and mark it paid; the plugin never connects to a payment service.

Commission rules by product and category

Rules decide what each referred product earns. They run from the top: the first match sets that product’s commission, and the Store default rule catches the rest.

  • Pay a percentage of the discounted line total, excluding tax and shipping, or a fixed amount per item.
  • Match products or product categories (is any of, is none of). All of a rule’s conditions must match.
  • Add, edit, reorder, duplicate and switch off as many rules as you need. A rate of 0 pays nothing.
  • An order’s commission is rounded half-up once, to 2 decimal places.

Performance bonuses

Reward an affiliate once for reaching a number of approved referrals or an amount of approved sales. The fixed bonus waits in Manage Referrals for your approval, like a commission; only approved order commissions count towards a target.

Refund safeguards

These need no setting:

  • A fully refunded order’s pending commission is marked Refunded. A cancelled or failed order’s is marked Rejected.
  • After a partial refund, a pending commission waits for your decision.
  • Approved commissions are never changed, and their records cannot be deleted.

Affiliate dashboard

Overview cards and charts, a referral-link card with a copy button, a link builder for any page of your store, rates and bonuses, commission history, a day-wise report, payout requests and a profile. Bank details include country, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC and a national bank code.

Emails

Four default emails with fixed text go out from your store’s address: signup, affiliate approved, new commission and withdrawal request (to the store admin). A password change sends a notice; passwords are never emailed.

Privacy

  • Visit records hold the affiliate, the page visited (without one-time keys), a count and a time; no IP address or browser details.
  • Two short-lived tracking counters (a request limit per address, one counted link opening per visitor a day) are stored under a hash keyed with your site’s secret, never the address. Deleting the plugin removes them.
  • Profile pictures use WordPress’s avatar function, which loads from Gravatar by default.
  • Personal data exports include the affiliate’s data. Erasure removes payment details and keeps commission and payout records for bookkeeping.

Compatibility

Tested from WordPress 6.6, WooCommerce 9.0 and PHP 7.4 up to WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.2 and PHP 8.4, with classic and block checkout and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS). Fonts and scripts load from your own site.

Free vs Pro

Free in this plugin, with no usage limits, licence key or trial:

  • Affiliate registration in four form designs, automatic approval, and activating or deactivating affiliates
  • Referral links, a link builder, a cookie duration you set, and first-click or last-click credit
  • Order tracking with classic and block checkout
  • Unlimited commission rules by product and product category, as a percentage or a fixed amount per item
  • Performance bonuses for approved referrals or approved sales
  • The affiliate dashboard, with its tables, charts and day-wise report
  • Payout requests, bank details and manual payouts
  • Refund safeguards, self-referral protection, four default emails and the program overview

Some admin screens also show Pro features as labelled, disabled previews with sample values; they save nothing and run nothing on your store.

Pro is a separate paid plugin, Affiliate and Referral Program for WooCommerce. It runs on the same data with no import and adds:

  • Advanced commission rules. Set rates for specific affiliates, affiliate groups or levels. Add conditions such as product tags, sale items, order subtotal or a customer’s first order, and match all or any of them. Schedule a rule with start and end dates for a campaign, and check the outcome with a preview and a test tool. Also a fixed amount per order, a monthly commission cap and an optional checkout discount for referred customers.
  • Affiliate groups and levels. Put affiliates into groups. Create named levels with their own requirements, pay each level its own rate through the rules, and show affiliates their level and their progress to the next one.
  • Multi-level (MLM) commissions. Also reward the affiliates above the one who made the sale. You choose the plan, the depth and a rate per level; each affiliate sees a genealogy tree of their downline and its sales.
  • Lifetime attribution. A signed-in customer stays linked to the affiliate who first referred them, so later orders earn commission without another click. Also manual referral entry, commission only for the page that was shared, a custom link parameter and commission on WooCommerce Subscriptions renewals.
  • More bonuses. Performance bonuses with several conditions, such as commission earned, a level reached or team results; sign-up, pay-per-click and social-sharing bonuses; and a bonus when a referred visitor submits a Contact Form 7 form.
  • Affiliate coupons. Every affiliate can get a personal coupon automatically, and an order that uses it is credited to them without a link. Affiliates can also turn wallet balance into a store coupon.
  • Customer Refer & Earn. Customers refer friends from My Account: the friend gets a discount, and the customer earns store credit to spend in your store.
  • Payouts and wallet. Pay requests in bulk through PayPal, or through Stripe with a free add-on. Set withdrawal limits and a fee, let affiliates pay for their own orders from their wallet, and give them a passbook of every wallet movement.
  • Marketing tools. QR codes for referral links, promotional banners, social sharing buttons and a product CSV for affiliates.
  • Registration and branding. Approve new affiliates by hand, add custom registration fields, choose a second dashboard template, set the dashboard’s colours and show it under WooCommerce My Account.
  • Emails and notifications. Eight editable emails with placeholders, test sends and on/off switches, an admin copy of commission emails, and announcements on the affiliate dashboard.
  • Refund management. Handle refunds automatically or by hand, hold approvals until a return period ends, and take back commission that was already approved.
  • Imports, exports and reports. Import affiliates from a CSV file, export affiliates and referrals as CSV or PDF, and use an advanced report with sales, visits, devices and a day-wise table. Translations for 12 languages are included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or later.
  2. In Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for RTW Affiliate Program for WooCommerce, then install and activate it. The affiliate dashboard page is created automatically.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Affiliate & Referral and set your Store default rule and the cookie duration.
  4. Add rules for any products or categories that should earn a different rate.
  5. Share the dashboard page so affiliates can sign up.
sections.faq:
Is this a free affiliate plugin for WooCommerce?

Yes. There is no licence key, trial or usage limit: you can have any number of affiliates, commission rules and referred orders. A separate paid Pro plugin adds more features; Free vs Pro in the description lists both sides.

Does this WordPress affiliate plugin need WooCommerce?

Yes. It is an affiliate plugin for WordPress stores that run WooCommerce 9.0 or later, and it tracks WooCommerce orders only. It does not work with other e-commerce, membership or form plugins.

How does WooCommerce affiliate tracking work?

A referral link sets a first-party cookie for 30 days, or the number you set. The last affiliate link followed gets the credit unless you choose first click. The visitor’s next order counts for that affiliate; the cookie is removed when its commission is recorded or its order-received page opens, so later orders need a new click. A referral also ends when the cookie expires or is deleted, and does not follow the visitor to another browser or device.

Can I pay different rates for different products?

Yes. Commission rules pay a percentage or a fixed amount per item for the products or product categories you choose. Rules run from the top and the first match decides; the Store default covers everything else, and a rate of 0 pays nothing.

How do I pay my affiliates?

With manual payouts: an affiliate’s payout request reserves the amount, you pay outside the plugin (for example by bank transfer) and mark it paid. If you reject a request, the amount returns to the affiliate’s balance. PayPal payouts, and Stripe payouts through a free add-on, are Pro.

Can affiliates earn commission on their own orders?

Not by default. Self-referral protection covers their signed-in purchases and guest checkouts that use their email address.

What happens when a referred order is refunded or cancelled?

Its pending commission is marked Refunded or Rejected; after a partial refund you decide. Approved commissions never change.

Can I use it for Amazon or other affiliate links?

No. It runs your own store’s affiliate program, not links to other stores’ programs.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Its temporary records, such as the request counters, are removed. Affiliates, commissions, rules, balances and payout history stay for Pro or a later reinstall.

What happens if I upgrade to Pro?

This plugin goes dormant while Pro is active, and Pro uses the same data, rules and bonuses with no import. If you deactivate Pro, this plugin resumes on that data; a rule or bonus with Pro-only options does not run here (its orders wait, the bonus is skipped). A custom link slug saved in Pro is kept but not used here; links that carry it track only under Pro. Under Pro, refunds follow Pro’s refund mode and the last click is credited.
